name: QA Automation Engineer
description: We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer with 5+ years of experience. You will design and implement automated test frameworks using Playwright and Cucumber. Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and CI/CD pipelines is required. You will collaborate closely with development teams to ensure quality across all products.

name: Frontend Developer
description: Seeking a Senior Frontend Developer proficient in React, TypeScript, and modern CSS frameworks. You will build scalable UI components, define front-end architecture, and collaborate closely with design and product teams. 5+ years of professional frontend experience required.

name: Product Manager
description: We are hiring a Product Manager to lead our core platform product. You will define roadmaps, work cross-functionally with engineering and design, and drive OKR achievement. 5+ years of PM experience in B2B SaaS required.
